purpose: Short release regression comparison, not peak throughput or an SLA.
scope: One host on the same JuiceFS mount; fresh unique root for every round.
No global cache eviction; immediate data reads and repeated recovery use potentially warm client/server caches.
Sequential phase all includes 1 GiB publication/read, 500 WAL frames, 2000 catalog frames, five recoveries, 64 commits and 3 GC trials per round.
Only two process rounds per build; replay and latency samples within a round are not independent process trials.
Current/baseline ratios above one mean slower for seconds and faster for MiB/s.
Publication p99 uses nearest rank over 32 values per round, so it is the sample maximum; no population-tail guarantee.
No attribution of changes to proof erasure alone: this compares complete builds including new runtime safety protocols.
